  flex: 1;
  position: relative;
  background: #3a6ea5; /* 桌面背景色 */
  overflow: hidden;
}

.welcome-screen {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  height: 100%;
  color: #ffffff;
  font-family: 'MS Sans Serif', Tahoma, sans-serif;
}

.welcome-screen h2 {
  margin-bottom: 1rem;
  color: #ffffff;
  font-size: 16px;
  font-weight: normal;
}

.welcome-screen p {
  color: #ffffff;
  font-size: 11px;
}

/* 桌面图标样式 */
.desktop-icon {
  position: absolute;
  width: 64px;
  height: 76px;
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  align-items: center;
  cursor: pointer;
  user-select: none;
  padding: 2px;
}

.desktop-icon:hover {
  background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.15);
  border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.3);
}

.desktop-icon.selected {
  background: #316ac5;
  border: 1px dotted #ffffff;
}

/* 选中时显示完整文件名的扩展样式 */
.desktop-icon.selected.expanded {
  height: auto; /* 允许高度自动调整 */
  min-height: 76px; /* 保持最小高度 */
}

.desktop-icon.hidden-window {
  opacity: 0.7;
}

.desktop-icon-image {
  width: 32px;
  height: 32px;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  font-size: 24px;
  margin-bottom: 4px;
}

.desktop-icon-thumbnail {
  width: 100%;
  height: 100%;
  object-fit: cover;
  border-radius: 2px;
}

.desktop-icon-emoji {
  font-size: 24px;
}

.desktop-icon-label {
  color: #ffffff;
  font-size: 11px;
  text-align: center;
  line-height: 13px;
  font-family: 'MS Sans Serif', Tahoma, sans-serif;
  text-shadow: 1px 1px 1px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.8);
  max-width: 100%;
  margin-top: 2px;
  min-height: 17px; /* 确保有足够的高度容纳输入框 */
  display: flex;
  align-items: flex-start; /* 改为顶部对齐，避免文字被截断 */
  justify-content: center;
  overflow: visible; /* 改为可见，让完整文件名显示时能超出 */
  position: relative; /* 为绝对定位的完整文件名提供相对定位基准 */
}

/* 扩展状态下的标签样式 */
.desktop-icon.expanded .desktop-icon-label {
  max-height: none; /* 移除高度限制 */
  height: auto; /* 允许自动调整高度 */
}

.desktop-icon-title-text {
  display: -webkit-box;
  -webkit-line-clamp: 3; /* 最多显示3行 */
  -webkit-box-orient: vertical;
  overflow: hidden;
  text-overflow: ellipsis;
  word-break: break-word;
  hyphens: auto;
  max-width: 100%;
  line-height: 13px;
  padding-top: 1px; /* 添加少量顶部padding确保第一行完整显示 */
}

/* 扩展状态下显示完整文件名 */
.desktop-icon.expanded .desktop-icon-title-text {
  -webkit-line-clamp: none; /* 移除行数限制 */
  overflow: visible; /* 显示所有内容 */
  text-overflow: clip; /* 不使用省略号 */
  display: block; /* 改为块级显示 */
}

.desktop-icon-rename-input {
  background: transparent; /* 透明背景，让选中框的背景显示 */
  color: #ffffff;
  border: none; /* 移除边框，使用选中框的边框 */
  font-size: 11px;
  font-family: 'MS Sans Serif', Tahoma, sans-serif;
  text-align: center;
  padding: 1px; /* 减少内边距 */
  width: 100%; /* 填满标签区域 */
  height: auto; /* 允许高度自动调整 */
  min-height: 17px; /* 最小高度确保可见 */
  outline: none;
  box-sizing: border-box;
  resize: none;
  overflow: visible; /* 允许内容可见，避免滚动条 */
  line-height: 13px;
  word-wrap: break-word;
  white-space: pre-wrap; /* 保留换行符 */
  vertical-align: top; /* 顶部对齐 */
  text-shadow: 1px 1px 1px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.8); /* 添加文字阴影，与普通文本一致 */
  
  /* 确保输入过程中样式稳定 */
  transition: none;
}

/* 窗口样式 */
.canvas-window {
  position: absolute;
  background: #c0c0c0;
  border-top: 2px solid #dfdfdf;
  border-left: 2px solid #dfdfdf;
  border-right: 2px solid #404040;
  border-bottom: 2px solid #404040;
  box-shadow: 1px 1px 0px #000000;
  font-family: 'MS Sans Serif', Tahoma, sans-serif;
  min-width: 200px;
  min-height: 120px;
  overflow: hidden;
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
}

.canvas-window.focused {
  z-index: 1000;
}

.canvas-window.dragging {
  z-index: 1001;
}

/* 窗口标题栏样式 */
.window-header {
  background: linear-gradient(to right, #0a246a, #a6caf0);
  color: #ffffff;
  padding: 1px 2px;
  display: flex;
  justify-content: space-between;
  align-items: center;
  font-size: 11px;
  font-weight: bold;
  cursor: move;
  height: 18px;
  font-family: 'MS Sans Serif', Tahoma, sans-serif;
}

.canvas-window:not(.focused) .window-header {
  background: linear-gradient(to right, #404040, #c0c0c0);
  color: #c0c0c0;
}

.window-title {
  flex: 1;
  overflow: hidden;
  text-overflow: ellipsis;
  white-space: nowrap;
  font-family: 'MS Sans Serif', sans-serif;
}

.window-title-input {
  background: #ffffff;
  border: 1px inset #c0c0c0;
  font-size: 11px;
  font-family: 'MS Sans Serif', sans-serif;
  padding: 1px 2px;
  color: #000000;
  flex: 1;
}

.window-controls {
  display: flex;
  gap: 1px;
}

.minimize-btn, .close-btn {
  width: 16px;
  height: 14px;
  background: #c0c0c0;
  border-top: 1px solid #dfdfdf;
  border-left: 1px solid #dfdfdf;
  border-right: 1px solid #404040;
  border-bottom: 1px solid #404040;
  font-size: 8px;
  font-weight: bold;
  cursor: pointer;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  color: #000000;
  font-family: 'MS Sans Serif', Tahoma, sans-serif;
  margin: 1px;
  line-height: 1;
}

.close-btn {
  font-size: 10px;
  padding-bottom: 1px;
}

.minimize-btn:hover, .close-btn:hover {
  background: #dfdfdf;
}

.minimize-btn:active, .close-btn:active {
  border-top: 1px solid #404040;
  border-left: 1px solid #404040;
  border-right: 1px solid #dfdfdf;
  border-bottom: 1px solid #dfdfdf;
  background: #a6a6a6;
}

/* 窗口内容区域 */
.window-content {
  flex: 1;
  overflow: hidden; /* 让子组件控制滚动 */
  padding: 0; /* 移除padding，让TextEditor完全控制 */
  background: #c0c0c0;
}

/* 窗口内的各种内容样式 */
.text-editor {
  width: 100%;
  height: 100%;
  border-top: 1px solid #808080;
  border-left: 1px solid #808080;
  border-right: 1px solid #dfdfdf;
  border-bottom: 1px solid #dfdfdf;
  background: #ffffff;
  font-family: 'MS Sans Serif', Tahoma, sans-serif;
  font-size: 11px;
  padding: 4px;
  resize: none;
  color: #000000;
  outline: none;
}

.image-placeholder {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  height: 100%;
  border-top: 1px solid #808080;
  border-left: 1px solid #808080;
  border-right: 1px solid #dfdfdf;
  border-bottom: 1px solid #dfdfdf;
  background: #ffffff;
  cursor: pointer;
  color: #808080;
  font-family: 'MS Sans Serif', Tahoma, sans-serif;
  font-size: 11px;
}

.video-placeholder, .audio-placeholder, .pdf-placeholder {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  height: 100%;
  border-top: 1px solid #808080;
  border-left: 1px solid #808080;
  border-right: 1px solid #dfdfdf;
  border-bottom: 1px solid #dfdfdf;
  background: #ffffff;
  cursor: pointer;
  color: #808080;
  font-family: 'MS Sans Serif', Tahoma, sans-serif;
  font-size: 11px;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 8px;
}

/* 窗口缩放手柄 */
.resize-handle {
  position: absolute;
  bottom: 0;
  right: 0;
  width: 12px;
  height: 12px;
  cursor: nw-resize;
  background-image: 
    linear-gradient(135deg, transparent 46%, #404040 46%, #404040 54%, transparent 54%),
    linear-gradient(45deg, transparent 46%, #404040 46%, #404040 54%, transparent 54%);
  background-size: 3px 3px;
  background-position: 0 0, 6px 6px;
  background-repeat: no-repeat;
}

/* 空画布提示 */
.empty-canvas {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  height: 100%;
  color: #ffffff;
  font-family: 'MS Sans Serif', Tahoma, sans-serif;
  text-shadow: 1px 1px 1px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.8);
}

.empty-canvas p {
  margin: 6px 0;
  font-size: 11px;
}

/* Windows 98 风格右键菜单 */
.context-menu {
  position: absolute;
  background: #c0c0c0;
  border-top: 2px solid #dfdfdf;
  border-left: 2px solid #dfdfdf;
  border-right: 2px solid #404040;
  border-bottom: 2px solid #404040;
  box-shadow: 1px 1px 0px #000000;
  font-family: 'MS Sans Serif', Tahoma, sans-serif;
  font-size: 11px;
  min-width: 140px;
  z-index: 9999;
  user-select: none;
  padding: 2px;
}

.context-menu-item {
  padding: 3px 20px 3px 6px;
  cursor: pointer;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  color: #000000;
  position: relative;
  font-family: 'MS Sans Serif', Tahoma, sans-serif;
  margin: 1px;
}

.context-menu-item:hover {
  background: #316ac5;
  color: #ffffff;
}

.context-menu-item.disabled {
  color: #808080;
  cursor: default;
}

.context-menu-item.disabled:hover {
  background: transparent;
  color: #808080;
}

.context-menu-icon {
  width: 16px;
  height: 16px;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  font-size: 12px;
  flex-shrink: 0;
  margin-right: 4px;
}

.context-menu-separator {
  height: 1px;
  background: #808080;
  border-top: 1px solid #dfdfdf;
  margin: 3px 6px;
}



.context-menu-submenu-arrow {
  position: absolute;
  right: 8px;
  font-size: 8px;
  color: inherit;
}

.context-menu-submenu-arrow::before {
  content: '▶';
}

/* 子菜单样式 */
.context-submenu {
  position: absolute;
  left: 100%;
  top: -2px;
  background: #c0c0c0;
  border-top: 2px solid #dfdfdf;
  border-left: 2px solid #dfdfdf;
  border-right: 2px solid #404040;
  border-bottom: 2px solid #404040;
  box-shadow: 1px 1px 0px #000000;
  font-family: 'MS Sans Serif', Tahoma, sans-serif;
  font-size: 11px;
  min-width: 160px;
  z-index: 10001;
  user-select: none;
  display: none;
  padding: 2px;
}

.context-menu-item.has-submenu {
  position: relative;
}

.context-menu-item.has-submenu:hover .context-submenu {
  display: block;
}

.context-submenu .context-menu-item {
  padding: 3px 20px 3px 6px;
  position: relative;
  margin: 1px;
  font-family: 'MS Sans Serif', Tahoma, sans-serif;
}

.context-submenu .context-menu-item:hover {
  background: #316ac5;
  color: #ffffff;
}

/* 确保有子菜单的项目有箭头空间 */
.context-menu-item.has-submenu {
  padding-right: 24px;
}

/* 文件拖放样式 */
.canvas-area {
  transition: background-color 0.2s ease;
}

.canvas-area:hover {
  background-color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.02);
}

/* 拖放时的视觉反馈 */
.canvas-area.drag-over {
  background-color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.1);
  border: 2px dashed rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.5);
}

.empty-canvas {
  transition: all 0.2s ease;
}

.empty-canvas:hover {
  background-color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.05);
}

/* 通用窗口样式 */
.generic-window-content {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  height: 100%;
  padding: 20px;
}

.generic-options {
  text-align: center;
  background: #f0f0f0;
  border: 2px inset #c0c0c0;
  padding: 20px;
  border-radius: 4px;
}

.generic-options h3 {

  font-family: 'MS Sans Serif', Tahoma, sans-serif;

}

.option-buttons {

}

.option-btn {

}

.option-btn:hover {

}

.option-btn:active {

  background: #b0b0b0;
}

.option-btn:focus {
  outline: 1px dotted #000000;
  outline-offset: -3px;
}

/* Markdown编辑器样式 */
.markdown-editor {
  display: flex;

  height: 100%;
  background: #ffffff;
  font-family: 'MS Sans Serif', Tahoma, sans-serif;
}

.markdown-toolbar {
  display: flex;
  gap: 2px;
  padding: 4px;
  background: #c0c0c0;
  border-bottom: 1px solid #808080;
  border-top: 1px solid #ffffff;
  border-left: 1px solid #ffffff;
  border-right: 1px solid #808080;
}

.toolbar-btn {
  background: #c0c0c0;
  border: 1px outset #c0c0c0;
  padding: 4px 8px;
  cursor: pointer;
  font-size: 11px;
  font-family: 'MS Sans Serif', Tahoma, sans-serif;
  color: #000000;
  min-width: 60px;

}

.toolbar-btn:hover {

}

.toolbar-btn:active,
.toolbar-btn.active {
  border: 1px inset #c0c0c0;

}

.toolbar-btn:focus {
  outline: 1px dotted #000000;
  outline-offset: -3px;
}

.markdown-content {

}

.markdown-textarea {

  outline: none;
  overflow-y: auto;
}

.markdown-textarea:focus {

}

.markdown-preview {

  padding: 12px;

  font-size: 13px;

  color: #000000;
}

.markdown-preview h1 {
  font-size: 20px;

  border-bottom: 2px solid #c0c0c0;

}

  font-size: 16px;
  font-weight: bold;
  margin: 14px 0 10px 0;

}

.markdown-preview h3 {

  font-weight: bold;
  margin: 12px 0 8px 0;
  color: #000080;
}

  margin: 8px 0;
}

.markdown-preview ul,
.markdown-preview ol {
  margin: 8px 0;
  padding-left: 24px;
}

.markdown-preview li {
  margin: 4px 0;
}

.markdown-preview code {
  background: #f0f0f0;
  border: 1px solid #c0c0c0;

}

.markdown-preview pre {

  padding: 8px;

}

.markdown-preview pre code {
  background: none;

}

.markdown-preview blockquote {
  border-left: 4px solid #c0c0c0;
  margin: 8px 0;
  padding-left: 12px;

  font-style: italic;
}

.markdown-preview table {

}

.markdown-preview th,
.markdown-preview td {
  border: 1px solid #c0c0c0;

}

.markdown-preview th {
  background: #e0e0e0;

}

.markdown-preview a {
  color: #0000ee;
  text-decoration: underline;
}

.markdown-preview a:visited {

}

/* 数学公式样式 */

  font-size: 1em;
}

.markdown-preview .katex-display {
  margin: 12px 0;
  text-align: center;
}
